source: Mostly captured from the StockSteps REAL backend public API (snapshot, news, quotes, profiles, daily charts, fundamentals, search). Synthetic sample values remain where the provider plan returned nothing: 1D intraday charts, sparklines, LONGN, the older sample movers and the sector ETF benchmark quotes (XLK, XLY, XLC). news/company/MSFT.json also contains articles titled 'Sample:' that exercise news edge cases and the mock explanation generator. Mock mode fills other gaps (missing quote fields, fundamentals, P/E history, benchmark daily closes) with stable sample values; LONGN and TSLA keep their gaps to exercise missing-data states.
